reading.product_and_scene: Product: a Celsius energy drink can, Peach Vibe design (white/silver body with red 'PEACH VIBE' lettering and a green palm graphic), upright with its pull tab on top, held in the woman's right hand. Its size is about the span of her hand and wrist, and it sits at the same level as the notebook. Scene: a student's bedroom desk with a laptop on the left, an open notebook, a ceiling fan, anime-style and other posters on the wall, a bed with a patterned blanket at the right edge. The woman wears a lavender fleece top. Camera: static, eye-level, portrait framing; the two frames match in position.

reading.unclear: Single still frames cannot show motion, so whether the generated hand moves in a writing motion is not visible; the still shows the can gripped in the hand, not a pen-like tip on paper. The EXAMPLE frame is a single moment, so whether the pencil is writing or only held cannot be confirmed from the still. The green object at the mouth is the same in both frames but its nature is not clear. The composite's product sample (Cherry Cola and Peach Vibe cans) is a reference image; the can in the WRONG frame matches the Peach Vibe design, which can only be confirmed by that reference. The text on the can body beyond the brand and flavor is small and partly blurred.
